name: expansion-e3a
description: Expansion wave E3A audit — Tier-2 rows 19-22: recliner (upright / reclined + footrest linkage), wall-desk (floating braced / fold-down drop legs), loft-bed (open / built-in desk / wardrobe under-bed fit-outs), trestle-desk (A-frame / H-frame / adjustable pin-hole legs). Staged on OPEN GROUND beside the flat (the mounted wall-desk reads as a clean product shot at its 0.75 m worktop height, no wall occlusion) in the whole-flat ORBIT dollhouse camera whose ~3/4 elevation reveals float/attachment. Closeups target joints: footrest linkage, wall-desk braces/hinge, loft-bed post/fit-out joins, trestle leg-to-worktop.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setQualityTier?.('high'); s.exitRoomEditor?.(); s.setCameraMode?.('orbit'); })()

steps.name: place-grid
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const items = [ ['recliner',{}], ['recliner',{position:'reclined'}], ['wall-desk',{}], ['wall-desk',{style:'fold-down'}], ['loft-bed',{}], ['loft-bed',{under:'desk'}], ['loft-bed',{under:'wardrobe'}], ['trestle-desk',{}], ['trestle-desk',{legStyle:'trestle-h'}], ['trestle-desk',{legStyle:'adjustable'}] ]; const cols = 4; const dx = 2.7, dz = 3.2, x0 = 1.0, z0 = -8.5; const pos = {}; const list = items.map(([defId, props], i) => { const c = i % cols, r = Math.floor(i / cols); const x = x0 + c * dx, z = z0 + r * dz; const key = defId + ':' + JSON.stringify(props); pos[key] = [x, z]; return { id: 'audit-' + i, defId, position: [x, z], rotation: 0, props }; }); window.__auditPos = pos; s.setItems(list); return list.length; })()

steps.name: frame-recliner-up
steps.eval: (() => { const p = window.__auditPos['recliner:{}']; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection({ center: [p[0], 0.55, p[1]], radius: 1.3 }); })()
